record.one_liner: Lark (Larksuite) enterprise collaboration suite exposing Open Platform server APIs for messaging, docs, calendar, base and more
record.auth_notes: App ID and App Secret from the Developer Console are used as credentials (api_key). Tokens are tenant_access_token (app acts as itself), app_access_token, and user_access_token obtained through an OAuth 2.0 user authorization flow (oauth2). No basic username/password path documented.
record.access_notes: critic: access approval_required -> self_serve_free. Any developer can create a custom app in the Developer Console and get App ID/Secret; the only review is by the app's own tenant administrator (the developer's own org, not the vendor), so no vendor approval gates credentials. Free-plan tenant not independently confirmed on a pricing page, hence medium confidence.
record.api_notes: Server API docs cover many product areas (Contacts, Messaging, Docs, Calendar, Base, Approval, Tasks, Email, Admin and others). REST inferred from Server API structure.
record.blocker_notes: critic: ready_with_review/app_review -> ready/none. Tenant admin review of custom app scopes is internal to the developer's own tenant; only publishing a store app to other tenants requires Lark review.
